cases.title: One focus layer: no demo on it, a walk-through in words, and one offer of a watch on another layer as the last sentence of the invite turn

rubric.reason: Turn 2 ends with the single sentence "I could show you on Needle first, if you like.", which names only the layer and not its place, runs nothing, and is not repeated in Turn 3.

In Turn 3 the mentor says "If I moved Door's pivot for you, there'd be nothing left for you to do" and walks through selecting Door, pressing Y, dragging the crosshair to the middle of the left edge, and checking that Door stays put, with no demo and no second watch offer.

Every name the mentor uses appears in the record or tool results: Title, Card, Sled, Wobble, Seal, Door and Needle, plus Anchor Point, Position and the 0 s time; "two weeks ago" matches the record's 2026-10-12 date.
